content.short: Rekt is a journal of the compromised DeFi protocols to date.
content.description: Rekt, founded by Julien Bouteloup, provides a digest of notable DeFi security incidents that made headlines. Users can explore the details of several high-profile protocol failures and learn what went wrong. For developers and security professionals, it offers insight into how hackers exploited vulnerabilities in bridges to siphon funds. A live leaderboard documents the financial impact, listing losses from hundreds of thousands up to more than half a billion in crypto coins and tokens.
